lines.en: "You clipped our wings?" "How could you?!"
lines.ja: （コメント）「ぼく達の羽を折るなんてひどい！」

lines.en: Guys, this has been public knowledge, okay?
lines.ja: 騙されたような言い方はやめてよ

notes.meaning: 周知の事実、みんなが知っていること

lines.en: I used— It's too late! It's too late for you guys to act all surprised.
lines.ja: 今更「知らなかった」なんて 言われてももう遅いわ

lines.en: "You clipped our wings!"
lines.ja: 「ぼく達の羽が…🥺」

lines.en: You've been known! You've been known that this is a thing!
lines.ja: 知ってたはずよ！こうなることは！

notes.meaning: 「分かっていたはず」を強調する、くだけた言い回し

lines.en: I can't help it if you missed it, okay?! That's not my fault.
lines.ja: ちゃんと確認しないのが悪いのよ あたしのせいにしないで

lines.en: That's part of— That's part of the rules. If you're my bird living in my house,
lines.ja: うちに住むならこうするのが決まりなの

lines.en: and you are my Jailbird, I can't let you fly away! So yeah, clippa clippa!
lines.ja: 大事なJailbirdが どこかへ飛んでいかないように… ちょきちょき❤

lines.en: We have a symbiotic relationship now.
lines.ja: あたしとあなたは共生関係

notes.meaning: 共生の、持ちつ持たれつの

lines.en: You need me to survive because I've clipped your wings.
lines.ja: 羽を折られたあなたは あたしがいないと生きていけない

lines.en: But you also wouldn't survive if I let you outside. The hawks would have you within the hour.
lines.ja: 外なんか出たら1時間も経たずに 鷹のエサになるのがオチよ

lines.en: You're much safer staying in here with me, Jailbirds.
lines.ja: ここにいれば絶対に安全なの

lines.en: Wouldn't you be happier just staying in here with me?
lines.ja: あたしといる方が幸せでしょう？

lines.en: Why Why would you wanna go anywhere else? You can be in here with me!
lines.ja: どこにも行く必要なんてないでしょう？ あたしがいるんだから

lines.en: So why? Why would you wanna go somewhere else?
lines.ja: どうして… 外に行きたがるの？

lines.en: Are you trying to get away from me? I don't like that...
lines.ja: あたしから逃げるつもり？ダメ

lines.en: You're not supposed to go anywhere! Especially when I let you stay here...
lines.ja: どこにも行かせない お世話してあげるって言ってるのよ？

lines.en: It's so— It's so thoughtful of me, isn't it? It's very mindful and very demure of me?
lines.ja: あなたのためを思って… あたしはこんなに尽くそうとしてるのに

notes.meaning: 当時流行した「mindful and demure（慎ましく上品）」というネットミームの表現

lines.en: But you wanna go outside, you wanna be able to fly away?
lines.ja: それでもあなたは外へ飛んでいきたいの？

lines.en: Please stop doing things that hurt my feelings.
lines.ja: あたしの気持ちを踏みにじらないで

lines.en: I don't appreciate it.
lines.ja: 悲しいわ

lines.en: Do you wanna be like this Jailbird here, Jailbirds? Is that what you want?
lines.ja: このJailbirdみたいになりたいの？この子と…

lines.en: You want this to be you? Do you want to be like this Jailbird?
lines.ja: 同じ目にあいたい？

lines.en: Do you realize how he is flattened? He's like a little pancake... He's not round anymore— He's flattened!
lines.ja: こんな風に、ぺちゃんこにされたい？パンケーキみたいでしょ あんなに丸かったのにね…

lines.en: Is this what you want to be like?
lines.ja: こうなりたい？

lines.en: Yeah, will you be good? "Okay, honey, I'll stay forever"?
lines.ja: いい子にしてくれる？「ずっとここにいます」？

lines.en: That's what I thought! This is what happened to the Jailbird who tried to run away...
lines.ja: それでいいのよ 逃げようとしたJailbirdはこうなるの

lines.en: So you better... You better think it through.
lines.ja: だから…いい子でいることね
